implementation: Released EasyDesign regressor topology, vectorized LocallyConnected1D with preserved configurations and weights
epoch_selection: For each outer target fold, next existing target fold is inner validation; select best inner MSE epoch, reset, refit all outer training for that epoch count.
common_training: Both released-regressor retraining and frozen D/B/C refits use only uniquely reconstructed-context training records.
changes: No author augmentation, to keep one identical 30-min label per training record across methods.
Use TensorFlow 2.18 + tf-keras 2.18 for legacy SavedModel compatibility.
Gap encoding fills fifth channel, fixing missing dash in published FASTA_CODES lookup; graph architecture unchanged.
Raw linear regression output used for continuous target; classifier/shift/clamp deployment gate not used in retraining.
Vectorized local connections; original/pretrained and reset-weight forward, objective and all trainable-gradient parity verified before evaluation.
Legacy Adam in tf-keras2.18; retained released-layer kernel regularization. No change to learning rate or epoch-selection policy.
identity: EasyDesign released regressor retrained; not claimed to reproduce full CNN12ae training pipeline or reported paper test scores.
context_rules: All compatible mapping candidates must give identical 10 nt flanks; any incomplete candidate or conflicting flank excludes record. No label used.
